ops.title: cc-interact's shared store has no migrations ("never altered, migrated"). How should the new nullable `directives.event_seq` column land?
ops.body:
Add a migration (Recommended)
Options: Add a migration | Hard cut | No schema change | Drop single delivery
Notes: answered Nov 9 2026. Open recognizes the exact previous schema, runs one ALTER TABLE in a transaction and records the new fingerprint. All five tools (cc-slack, cc-review, cc-present, codex-ask, cci) keep their data; an unknown schema still fails or archives as today. This reverses the never-migrated rule for core tables only; each tool's own tables stay exact. Context: delivering each Slack message once needs to link a hook directive to its event.
